title: Hangover-Cure Malaysian Turkey Satay
description: A paleo-friendly, hangover-cure dish featuring turkey, flambe, and a mustardy, glassy-jelly sauce. This recipe is perfect for a weekend brunch or a midnight snack.
instructions: Combine turkey breast, coconut milk, mustard seeds, fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar in a blender or food processor.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add blended mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and caramelized.
Add water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened and reduced slightly.
Thread turkey onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add turkey skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Add sauce to wok or skillet and toss to coat turkey.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
